_doc: #637 — every asset on the rolling release must be referenced by a fleet-manifest row (apps[].asset / apps[].assets{}; lib rows are apps rows with kind lib, so a declared lib is covered by the same read). Sidecars (<asset>.sha256, <asset>.source) belong to the asset they name. Read by 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-release-orphan-guard.py. The bare rootfs tarballs and nixdroid bootstrap zips sat on the release for days after #628 made them unreachable because nothing compared the release against what the fleet still names.
_doc_retained: Orphans that are on the release ON PURPOSE or that await an owner decision, each with its reason. The list can only shrink: an entry that is no longer on the release, or that a manifest row now references, fails the guard as stale, so a retained name cannot outlive the asset it excuses. Adding an entry is the explicit, reviewable act; uploading an unreferenced asset without one is red.
